summary: 37-year-old Texas man separated from his brother in the dark while hiking ~1/2 mi from their parked car to a friend's cabin between MM 70 & 71 on Highway 34, Big Thompson Canyon; reported missing to LCSO ~12:35 a.m.; LCSAR searched at daybreak and recovered his body from the Big Thompson River at ~9:20 a.m. after a fisherman alerted searchers; cause/manner pending with the coroner
responding_agency: Larimer County Sheriff's Office + Larimer County Search & Rescue + Estes Valley Fire Protection District + Colorado State Patrol
notes: Incident date = 2018-07-27 (Friday, weekday-verified); body recovery, cause of death pending at publication
